articles.title: Parl forum for delivery, not drama, says PM Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi urged the opposition to stop using Parliament for expressing political frustration, especially after election defeats like in Bihar. He emphasized that the legislature's purpose is constructive debate and policymaking for national interest, not a platform for political grievances. Modi called for a focus on substantive issues rather than disrupting proceedings, highlighting the importance of parliamentary decorum for democratic functioning.

articles.title: IITs bar from placement drive 20+ companies that rescinded offers
articles.summary: IITs have blacklisted over 20 companies from their placement drives for rescinding job offers previously made to students. This decisive action aims to safeguard students' interests and uphold the integrity of the rigorous IIT placement process. It sends a strong message to recruiters about accountability, ensuring fair recruitment practices and protecting the career prospects of graduating engineers.

articles.title: Show results of anti-pollution steps: SC to Centre, NCR govts
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has directed the Centre and National Capital Region (NCR) governments to present concrete results of their anti-pollution measures. articles.title: Can give life convict bail during pendency of appeal if he has a fair chance of acquittal: SC
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has adopted a more lenient stance, ruling that a life convict can be granted bail during the pendency of their appeal. This is permissible if the individual demonstrates a 'fair chance of acquittal' and has already served a significant portion of their sentence. This decision reflects the court's evolving approach to balancing justice and individual liberty, potentially impacting many ongoing cases nationwide.

This emphasizes India's proactive stance on global security challenges and collective responsibility.
